title: Siralos user configuration
description: Trusted user-level Siralos configuration. Project repositories cannot broaden these settings.

profile.description: Session sandbox profile. Defaults to inspect.

backend.description: Sandbox backend selection. Defaults to auto.

godot.description: Trusted user-level Godot installation configuration. Project files cannot select or broaden executables.

activeInstallation.description: Installation id used by default. Must reference a configured or discovered installation.

path.description: Absolute path to a Godot executable (or macOS .app bundle). Relative paths are rejected.

editionHint.description: User-supplied edition hint. A hint only, never an authoritative result.

discoverOnPath.description: Whether fixed-name PATH discovery is enabled. Defaults to true.

quality.description: Trusted user-level development-quality configuration. An untrusted repository cannot alter these settings.

reviewProvider.description: Optional provider profile used for the independent change reviewer. Must reference an existing configured provider; a missing profile fails clearly and never silently falls back to an unrelated provider. Defaults to the active development provider profile.

references.description: Declared external read-only references, alias to declaration. Aliases match ^[a-z][a-z0-9._-]{1,63}$; at most 16 references. Unknown keys are rejected at every level so credential fields cannot hide. Semantic validation (absolute paths, repository normalization, ref bounds) is enforced by the application.

additionalProperties.description: One reference declaration. Exactly one of path (local-directory) or repository (repository) applies per kind.

kind.description: local-directory references point at an absolute path outside the workspace; repository references pin a remote GitHub repository.

path.description: Absolute path to the local-directory reference. Relative paths are rejected by the application.

ref.description: Optional repository pin; exactly one of commit/tag/branch. Absent refs default to the mutable branch main and are refused without an explicit pin.

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the reference (bounded to 512 bytes by the application).
